name: reach-species
cmd: set -e; export BLR_DEVICE=cuda BLR_MAX_ITER=100 BLR_STARTS=0.5; {python} research/exp/fair_rivals.py --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1 --esk-dir {outroot}/E059/reach_esk/t1995 --early 1966 1971 --out {out}/t1995_w1966 --incremental --n-pos 96 --pos-seeds 1 2 --strong-base --lean --tag _p96dev --target dev; {python} research/exp/fair_rivals.py --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1 --esk-dir {outroot}/E059/reach_esk/t1995 --early 1972 1977 --out {out}/t1995_w1972 --incremental --n-pos 96 --pos-seeds 1 2 --strong-base --lean --tag _p96dev --target dev; {python} research/exp/fair_rivals.py --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1 --esk-dir {outroot}/E059/reach_esk/t1995 --early 1978 1983 --out {out}/t1995_w1978 --incremental --n-pos 96 --pos-seeds 1 2 --strong-base --lean --tag _p96dev --target dev; {python} research/exp/fair_rivals.py --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1 --esk-dir {outroot}/E059/reach_esk/t1995 --early 1984 1989 --out {out}/t1995_w1984 --incremental --n-pos 96 --pos-seeds 1 2 --strong-base --lean --tag _p96dev --target dev; {python} research/exp/fair_rivals.py --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s1 --esk-dir {outroot}/E059/reach_esk/t1995 --early 1990 1995 --out {out}/t1995_w1990 --incremental --n-pos 96 --pos-seeds 1 2 --strong-base --lean --tag _p96dev --target dev; {python} research/exp/fair_rivals.py --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1985_s1 --esk-dir {outroot}/E059/reach_esk/t1985 --early 1966 1971 --out {out}/t1985_w1966 --incremental --n-pos 96 --pos-seeds 1 2 --strong-base --lean --tag _p96dev --target dev; {python} research/exp/fair_rivals.py --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1985_s1 --esk-dir {outroot}/E059/reach_esk/t1985 --early 1972 1977 --out {out}/t1985_w1972 --incremental --n-pos 96 --pos-seeds 1 2 --strong-base --lean --tag _p96dev --target dev; {python} research/exp/fair_rivals.py --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1985_s1 --esk-dir {outroot}/E059/reach_esk/t1985 --early 1978 1983 --out {out}/t1985_w1978 --incremental --n-pos 96 --pos-seeds 1 2 --strong-base --lean --tag _p96dev --target dev
summarize: for f in {out}/*/fair_rivals_incr_p96*.json; do {python} -c "import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); m=r['models']; h=r['head_to_head']; g=lambda d: '%+.3f [%+.3f,%+.3f]' % (d['diff'], *d['ci']); print(sys.argv[1].split('/')[-2].ljust(16), r.get('target'), r.get('early'), 'desk_within %.3f placebo %.3f strong %.3f | desk-placebo %s | desk-strong %s' % (m['desk_within']['corr'], m['placebo_300']['corr'], m['strong']['corr'], g(h['desk_within - placebo_300']), g(h['desk_within - strong'])))" $f; done
note: E059f: per-window backcast by reach, OUT-OF-COMMUNITY species, seed 1 selected (fast BLR)
